kvetch.e: From Yiddish קוועטשן (kvetshn, literally “to squeeze, pinch”), from Middle High German quetschen (“crush, press”).

s.d: A person who endlessly whines or complains; a person who finds fault with anything.

express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
